description: This file defines a singleton object 'KeyEventExtensions' which provides utility functions to detect specific key events such as Enter or D-PAD Center for TV remote navigation.

classes.name: KeyEventExtensions
classes.description: A singleton utility object providing extension functions related to KeyEvent handling, specifically for detecting Enter key presses.

methods.name: isEnter
methods.description: Determines if the given keyCode corresponds to an Enter key press (either D-PAD Center or Enter).
